facts.text: Graduates of the Practical Nursing program continuing into the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program can receive an alumni scholarship of up to $5,000 based on financial need.

sources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Nursing Scholarships and Financial Aid
sources.quote: Practical Nursing Alumni Scholarship: Designed to help graduates of Provo College's Practical Nursing (PN) program level up their skills with a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN), this scholarship pays up to a total of $5,000 based on financial need.
